# Phase 26 — syntax-aware structured integration

Phase 26 adopts an external Mergiraf-class resolver as a lower R6 rung. It does not implement a
parser, subtree matcher, CPG merge, or behavioral-equivalence engine. `ff-only` remains the
default integration strategy. `structured` is explicit and local-only.

## SM1 — injected external resolver

The production resolver invokes `mergiraf solve <conflicted-path>` with fixed arguments, bounded
    10|time/output, and no shell. Tests inject the executor. A missing, failed, timed-out, or unknown
resolver outcome refuses typed; Baton never relabels textual fallback as structured success.

## SM2 — main is never the staging workspace

Baton checks main cleanliness and pins its HEAD, then creates a detached integration worktree
under `.baton/integrate/`. The three-way merge, conflict resolution, index updates, and merge
commit occur only there. Any pre-finalize failure leaves main HEAD, index, and worktree unchanged.

## SM3 — exact Git identities
    20|
The stage pins `beforeSha`, accepted `resultSha`, their merge base, a two-parent `stageSha`, and the
conflicted paths. Invalid commits, an already-integrated result, dirty main, or a main advance
between staging and finalize refuses without rewriting history.

## SM4 — fail-closed conflict classification

A clean Git three-way merge is `clean_textual`. Each unresolved regular text path is passed to the
external resolver and may become `structured_resolved`. Binary/deleted/unsupported paths,
resolver parse fallback, non-success, remaining unmerged index entries, or any diff3 conflict
    30|marker refuse. Conflict classification is syntax/tool evidence, not a semantic-safety claim.

## SM5 — immutable candidate commit

Only a fully resolved and `git diff --check`-clean stage becomes a merge commit with exact left and
right parents. The candidate is not main and conveys no acceptance by existing alone.

## SM6 — fresh post-merge verification

Before main moves, Baton creates a distinct fresh verification worktree at `stageSha` and runs the
    40|task's immutable pinned primary verification command. The hub must observe its expected exit.
Failure is `structured_verification_failed`; the stage is reaped, the accepted result remains
pinned, and main is unchanged. Existing result-level red/green, coverage, mutation, and oracle
evidence remain attached; Phase 26 does not fabricate a second red baseline for the combined tree.

## SM7 — one guarded main update

Only after SM6 passes may Baton require main still clean and exactly at `beforeSha`, then
fast-forward it to `stageSha`. Success records before/result/base/stage/after SHAs, per-path
classes, resolver identity, and the fresh verdict. No push or deploy is implied.
    50|
## SM8 — replay and authority

Operational success plus the coordination integration batch remains the only replayable success.
An asymmetric decision, candidate commit, resolver report, CPG delta, or behavioral fingerprint
cannot reconstruct integration. Post-effect authority failure poisons and requires reconciliation;
Baton never silently hard-resets user state.

## SM9 — cleanup and retention

    60|Integration and verification worktrees are reaped on success, refusal, timeout, and thrown error.
Successful main retains the result and releases its result pin. Refusal retains
`refs/baton/results/<sha>` for recovery. No stage branch is created.

## SM10 — honest semantic boundary

CPG overlap and behavioral fingerprints are advisory only and may increase review or refuse; they
cannot skip SM6 or advance main. True semantic merge means resolving incompatible data/control-flow
edge mutations with sound source round-trip. It remains catalogued research until an adoptable
external engine and measured false-clean advantage exist. Redirect to structured merge plus fresh
    70|verification when that evidence is absent; retain a tombstone if evaluation retires the bet.

the pinned SHA.

The integration record pins before/result/merge-base/stage/after identities, per-path classes,
resolver evidence, and the fresh verdict. Refusal retains the accepted result ref. Post-effect
    20|coordination failure poisons; restart replay does not invent success. Startup reconciliation
removes orphan stages because an old candidate without a live fresh verdict has no authority.

## Validation

- Numbered contract: `spec/phase26/structured-merge.md` (SM1–SM10).
- Focused gate: 13/13.
- Existing acceptance/worktree plus Phase 26 gate: 67/67.
- Canonical owned suite: 763/763; suite root reaped.
- Reds cover unavailable resolver, marker retention, parse fallback, deployment file ceiling,
    30|  resolver isolation, clean divergent three-way merge, false-clean syntax failure, dirty main,
  main-advance race, post-main authority failure/replay, and orphan-stage reconciliation.
- The external `mergiraf` binary is absent on this host. Production invocation is implemented
  with fixed no-shell `mergiraf solve <path>` argv, bounded time/output, and a minimal environment;
  tests use an injected executor and do not claim a live external-tool pass.

## Recursive Baton scope review

Exact `grok-4.5` and `grok-composer-2.5-fast` independently reviewed the scope concurrently through
Baton before implementation. Both provider identities were observed on distinct overlapping PIDs,
    40|both reports were freshly verified, both workers were normally killed, and every process,
worktree, runtime, and branch was reaped. Both converged on isolated staging, an injected external
resolver, mandatory fresh verification, and an explicit ban on CPG/fingerprint merge authority.
The reports and lifecycle ledger are under
`docs/reference/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-scope-grok-review-2026-07-11/`.

NUL-containing Git-binary conflicts could reach a cooperative resolver; Composer found a
delimiter-free marker evasion and ambient `GIT_*` control of local Git subprocesses. All three now
have reds. Binary conflicts refuse before resolver invocation, marker scanning rejects any run of
    50|seven or more diff3 marker characters at line start, and local worktree Git strips ambient Git
variables, disables system/global configuration, and disables hooks for merge/commit. The initial
implementation reports and complete kill/reap ledger are under
`docs/reference/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-implementation-grok-review-2026-07-11/`.

behavioral fingerprints may later escalate review or refusal, but there is deliberately no hook by
    60|which either can advance main or skip verification. True data/control-flow merge remains a
catalogued research bet pending an adoptable external engine, measured residual demand after this
rung, and an evidence-backed false-clean advantage.

Reviewed at commit `977f951` against `spec/phase26/structured-merge.md`, `impl/src/{structured-merge,worktree,coordinator,index}.mjs`, `impl/test/phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs`, `docs/handoff/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-2026-07-11.md`, and Phase 11 integration/replay tests (`impl/test/phase11-acceptance-integration.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase11-coordination-store.test.mjs`). Findings are grounded in source locations and reproducible sequences; resolver and evidence prose are not trusted.

## Decision

**One actionable SM1–SM10 defect remains.**

SM4 refuses binary **input** conflicts (`worktree.mjs:297`) but does not scan resolver **output** for embedded NUL before staging the merged bytes (`worktree.mjs:306–314`). A malicious injected resolver can return `{ status: 'resolved' }` with syntactically valid UTF-8 text plus `\0`, pass marker and `git diff --check` gates, survive weak pinned verification, and land on main. That violates SM4’s fail-closed binary classification at the Baton TCB boundary; it is not excused as external-tool trust or true-semantic-merge non-goal.

All other SM1–SM10 seams reviewed here are implemented and evidenced to spec, with explicit non-goals called out below (live `mergiraf`, line-anchored marker policy, verification strength, semantic merge).

## Proposed numbered contract

### SM1 — injected external resolver

**Verdict: PASS (implementation); live binary unvalidated (explicit non-goal).**

`MergirafResolver` (`structured-merge.mjs:25–57`) requires deployment-derived `timeoutMs`, `maxOutputBytes`, and `maxFileBytes`; spawns with `shell: false` and fixed argv `['solve', relativePath]` (`structured-merge.mjs:41–44`); bounds stdout/stderr during read and after close (`structured-merge.mjs:15–16`, `51–52`); times out with `SIGKILL` (`structured-merge.mjs:21–22`); passes minimal env `{ PATH, LANG: 'C', LC_ALL: 'C' }` (`structured-merge.mjs:43`); classifies `parse_fallback` via stdout/stderr regex (`structured-merge.mjs:53`), non-zero exit as `unresolved` (`54`), missing “Solved N conflict” as `unknown` (`55`), else `resolved` (`56`). Missing resolver at staging yields `structured_tool_unavailable` (`worktree.mjs:292`). Coordinator never maps fallback/unknown/unresolved to success (`worktree.mjs:310–311`, `coordinator.mjs:1157`).

**Non-goal:** Evidence states `mergiraf` is absent on the host; production binary behavior is not red-tested (`docs/handoff/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-2026-07-11.md:32–34`).

### SM2 — main is never the staging workspace

**Verdict: PASS.**

`stageStructuredIntegration` requires clean main (`worktree.mjs:270`), pins `beforeSha` (`274`), creates detached worktree under `.baton/integrate/` (`278–281`), runs merge/commit only in `stagePath` (`285–325`), and `removeStructuredIntegration` on any failure (`329–330`). `finalizeStructuredIntegration` is the sole main mutator via `--ff-only` (`342–343`). Coordinator always cleans verify path and stage in `finally`-style blocks (`coordinator.mjs:1161–1162`, `1176–1177`).

**Failure sequence (refusal leaves main untouched):** Accept worker result → dirty main with uncommitted bytes → `coordinator.integrate(..., { strategy: 'structured' })` → `structured_main_dirty` (`worktree.mjs:270`, test `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:105–110`) → HEAD and porcelain unchanged.

**GIT_* confinement:** `localGitEnv()` strips ambient `GIT_*`, sets `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1'` and `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: '/dev/null'` (`worktree.mjs:57–61`); merge/commit use `-c core.hooksPath=/dev/null` (`worktree.mjs:285`, `323`). Red: `GIT_INDEX_FILE` poison does not break clean three-way (`phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:95–103`).

### SM3 — exact Git identities

**Verdict: PASS.**

Staging records `beforeSha`, verified `resultSha`, `mergeBaseSha`, `stageSha`, `stagePath`, classes, resolutions (`worktree.mjs:274–277`, `325–328`). Refuses non-commit result (`272–273`), already-integrated result (`275–276`), and post-stage main advance (`336–341`). Candidate must have exactly two parents `[beforeSha, resultSha]` (`326–327`, `340–341`).

**Failure sequence (main-advance race):** Stage succeeds → main fast-forwards before finalize → `structured_main_advanced` (`worktree.mjs:339`, test `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:134–143`) → main stays at raced commit, stage reaped.

### SM4 — fail-closed conflict classification

**Verdict: FAIL — one actionable defect (binary output); otherwise PASS.**

**Implemented gates:** Clean merge → `clean_textual` (`289`). Unmerged paths require resolver (`291–292`). Path confinement via `pathRelative` and `isFile()` (`295–296`). Binary **input** via `conflict.includes(0)` (`297`). File budget pre/post resolve (`298`, `306`). Isolated resolver cwd outside repo (`299–303`, test asserts `isolatedCwd.startsWith(root) === false`, `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:77`). Parse fallback / unresolved / unknown refuse (`310–311`). Remaining unmerged index entries refuse (`319–320`). `git diff --check --cached` refuse (`321–322`). Line-anchored diff3 markers refuse via `CONFLICT_MARKER` (`254`, `312–313`; reds `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:43–54`).

**Actionable defect — binary resolver output not refused:**

| Step | Action | Location |
|------|--------|----------|
| 1 | Base repo; worker edits `src/value.js`; main diverges on same path | test harness `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:14–18` |
| 2 | Inject resolver: `writeFileSync(absolutePath, 'export const values = { alpha: 2 };\n\0evil')`; `return { status: 'resolved' }` | `worktree.mjs:303` |
| 3 | Input passes: no NUL in conflict blob (`297`), within `maxFileBytes` | `297–298` |
| 4 | Output passes: `merged.includes(0)` **not checked**; UTF-8 decode succeeds; no line-start marker | `306–313` |
| 5 | Bytes written to stage and committed (`314–325`); SM6 verification runs `node src/value.js` (may still exit 0) | `coordinator.mjs:1138–1157` |
| 6 | Main fast-forwards with NUL-corrupted text file | `finalizeStructuredIntegration` `342–343` |

**Expected contract:** refuse `structured_binary_conflict` (or equivalent) on merged buffer before `writeFileSync(absolutePath, merged)` — symmetric with `297`.

**Non-goals / accepted limits:**
- Line-anchored markers only (`254`); inline `<<<<<<<` mid-line is not scanned — evidence documents line-start policy (`docs/handoff/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-2026-07-11.md:49–50`).
- Invalid UTF-8 from resolver throws through `TextDecoder` fatal (`312`); outer handler maps non-`structured_*` to `structured_merge_failed` (`329–332`) — still refuses, weaker typing only.
- True semantic false-clean when verification is weak — honest boundary SM10 (`spec/phase26/structured-merge.md:64–70`); syntactic false-clean is red-tested (`phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:125–132`).

### SM5 — immutable candidate commit

**Verdict: PASS.**

Stage commits only after all paths resolved, index clean, and `diff --check` pass (`318–322`); merge commit message `baton structured integration: ${taskId}` (`323–324`); parent identity verified before return (`326–327`). Candidate is not main until SM7.

### SM6 — fresh post-merge verification

**Verdict: PASS.**

Coordinator builds **distinct** verify worktree at `stageSha` (`coordinator.mjs:1139–1140`), runs pinned primary via `_referee` (`1141–1144`), requires accept before finalize (`1145–1157`). Failure code `structured_verification_failed` (`1157`); main unchanged; stage/verify reaped (`1161–1162`). Event `integration.merge_reverified` logged (`1151–1155`). Red: invalid syntax after “resolved” (`phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:125–132`).

**Non-goal:** Verification command strength; spec admits pinned check may be weak (`spec/phase26/structured-merge.md:42–43`, evidence `57–59`).

### SM7 — one guarded main update

**Verdict: PASS.**

`finalizeStructuredIntegration` re-checks clean main at `beforeSha` (`337–339`), re-validates candidate parents (`340–341`), `merge --ff-only` (`342–343`). Success record includes SHAs, classes, resolutions, resolver identity, verdict (`coordinator.mjs:1158`, `1182–1186`). No push implied.

### SM8 — replay and authority

**Verdict: PASS.**

Operational `integration.completed` plus coordination batch required for replayed success. Phase 11 CK9: post-merge coordination failure poisons; replay shows `integration: null` (`phase11-acceptance-integration.test.mjs:301–322`); asymmetric Decision without driver authority rejected (`325–346`). Phase 26 SM8: structured path same pattern — main may move before authority failure, coordination poisons, replay does not invent structured success (`phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:155–167`). Coordinator maps `structured_*` codes through on refusal (`coordinator.mjs:1174`).

### SM9 — cleanup and retention

**Verdict: PASS.**

`retainResult` before integration (`coordinator.mjs:1119–1121`); `releaseResult` on success (`1178–1180`); refusal retains ref (SM1 test `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:40`). Stage/verify removed on success and error (`1161–1162`, `1176–1177`). `reconcile` sweeps orphan `.baton/integrate/*` (`worktree.mjs:473–487`, test `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:169–179`). No stage branch created (detached `worktree add --detach`, `280`).

### SM10 — honest semantic boundary

**Verdict: PASS.**

`coordinator.mjs` integration path has no Atlas/CPG/fingerprint hooks (grep empty). Structured advance requires SM6 verification; advisory signals cannot skip it per spec (`spec/phase26/structured-merge.md:64–70`). True semantic merge explicitly catalogued research non-goal.

## Red tests and proof

| Seam | Existing red / proof | Gap |
|------|----------------------|-----|
| SM1 missing resolver | `phase26:34–41` → `structured_tool_unavailable`, main pinned | Live `mergiraf` (non-goal) |
| SM1 argv / fallback class | `phase26:145–153` → `['solve', path]`, `shell: false`, `parse_fallback` | Timeout / `output_too_large` not in phase26 (impl present `structured-merge.mjs:15–22`) |
| SM2 main isolation | `phase26:105–110` dirty main; `77` isolated cwd; integrate dir reaped on failure | — |
| SM2 GIT env | `phase26:95–103` `GIT_INDEX_FILE` poison | — |
| SM3 identities / race | `phase26:134–143` `structured_main_advanced` | — |
| SM4 binary input | `phase26:56–64` NUL input, resolver uncalled | **Missing: NUL resolver output** |
| SM4 markers | `phase26:43–54` line-start evasion | Inline markers (documented policy) |
| SM4 fallback / file bound | `phase26:113–123` | — |
| SM5 parents / diff-check | Covered inside success path `phase26:66–83`, `85–93` | — |
| SM6 fresh verify | `phase26:66–83` `verdict.reverified`; `125–132` false-clean | — |
| SM7 guarded FF | Success assertions `phase26:76–78`; race `134–143` | — |
| SM8 replay | `phase26:155–167`; `phase11:301–346` | — |
| SM9 cleanup | `phase26:169–179` reconcile orphan | — |
| SM10 boundary | No integration hook (source inspection) | — |

**Proposed red (SM4 defect):**

```javascript
resolve: async ({ absolutePath }) => {
  writeFileSync(absolutePath, 'export const values = { alpha: 2 };\n\0');
  return { status: 'resolved' };
}
```

Expect `structured_binary_conflict` (or dedicated post-resolve code), main at `beforeSha`, `.baton/integrate` absent — mirroring `phase26:56–64` but **after** resolver returns.

## Risks and rejection criteria

**Reject Phase 26 structured merge for production if:**

1. **SM4 binary output gap unfixed** — malicious or buggy resolver can inject NUL into merged text files; violates fail-closed classification and bypasses input-side binary gate.
2. **Resolver confinement regresses** — resolver invoked with repo `stagePath` as cwd or full conflict path argv without isolation (`worktree.mjs:299–303` pattern broken).
3. **Main becomes merge workspace** — three-way merge or resolver write targets `repoRoot` directly instead of `.baton/integrate/` detached checkout.
4. **Ambient Git controls staging** — `GIT_*` or hooks alter merge/commit/index without `localGitEnv` + `core.hooksPath=/dev/null`.
5. **Textual fallback labeled success** — `parse_fallback`, `unknown`, or missing tool maps to `integration.completed` without `structured_*` refusal.
6. **SM6 skipped or reused main checkout** — verification runs on main tree or stale sandbox instead of fresh worktree at `stageSha`.
7. **Replay invents integration** — coordination poison or asymmetric Decision still yields `result().integration` on replay (CK9 violation).
8. **Orphan stages survive restart** — `.baton/integrate/*` not reaped by `reconcile` after crash between stage and finalize.

**Accepted non-goals (not rejection criteria):**

- Live Mergiraf binary correctness, parser coverage, or cross-language merge quality — external tool; Baton only bounds invocation and classifies stdout/evidence.
- True semantic merge / CPG-driven auto-integration — spec SM10 defers to research plus fresh verification.
- Inline conflict-marker evasion when policy is line-anchored seven-plus diff3 prefixes — documented in evidence; Git-native markers are line-based.
- Weak pinned verification allowing behavioral false-clean — operator must strengthen `brief.verification`; SM6 only enforces fresh run of the pinned command.

**Residual risk after fixing NUL output:** Structured merge remains syntax/tool evidence, not semantic safety (`spec/phase26/structured-merge.md:30–31`). Resolvers can still emit plausible-text wrong merges that pass narrow smoke tests; that is mitigated only by stronger verification or human review, not by Phase 26 scope.

# Phase 26 SM1–SM10 adversarial implementation review (977f951)

Reviewed at commit `977f951` against `spec/phase26/structured-merge.md`, `impl/src/{structured-merge,worktree,coordinator,index}.mjs`, `impl/test/phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs`, `docs/handoff/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-2026-07-11.md`, and Phase 11 integration/replay tests (`impl/test/phase11-acceptance-integration.test.mjs`, `impl/test/phase11-coordination-store.test.mjs`). Findings are grounded in source locations and reproducible sequences; resolver and evidence prose are not trusted.

## Decision

**One actionable SM1–SM10 defect remains.**

SM4 refuses binary **input** conflicts (`worktree.mjs:297`) but does not scan resolver **output** for embedded NUL before staging the merged bytes (`worktree.mjs:306–314`). A malicious injected resolver can return `{ status: 'resolved' }` with syntactically valid UTF-8 text plus `\0`, pass marker and `git diff --check` gates, survive weak pinned verification, and land on main. That violates SM4’s fail-closed binary classification at the Baton TCB boundary; it is not excused as external-tool trust or true-semantic-merge non-goal.

All other SM1–SM10 seams reviewed here are implemented and evidenced to spec, with explicit non-goals called out below (live `mergiraf`, line-anchored marker policy, verification strength, semantic merge).

## Proposed numbered contract

### SM1 — injected external resolver

**Verdict: PASS (implementation); live binary unvalidated (explicit non-goal).**

`MergirafResolver` (`structured-merge.mjs:25–57`) requires deployment-derived `timeoutMs`, `maxOutputBytes`, and `maxFileBytes`; spawns with `shell: false` and fixed argv `['solve', relativePath]` (`structured-merge.mjs:41–44`); bounds stdout/stderr during read and after close (`structured-merge.mjs:15–16`, `51–52`); times out with `SIGKILL` (`structured-merge.mjs:21–22`); passes minimal env `{ PATH, LANG: 'C', LC_ALL: 'C' }` (`structured-merge.mjs:43`); classifies `parse_fallback` via stdout/stderr regex (`structured-merge.mjs:53`), non-zero exit as `unresolved` (`54`), missing “Solved N conflict” as `unknown` (`55`), else `resolved` (`56`). Missing resolver at staging yields `structured_tool_unavailable` (`worktree.mjs:292`). Coordinator never maps fallback/unknown/unresolved to success (`worktree.mjs:310–311`, `coordinator.mjs:1157`).

**Non-goal:** Evidence states `mergiraf` is absent on the host; production binary behavior is not red-tested (`docs/handoff/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-2026-07-11.md:32–34`).

### SM2 — main is never the staging workspace

**Verdict: PASS.**

`stageStructuredIntegration` requires clean main (`worktree.mjs:270`), pins `beforeSha` (`274`), creates detached worktree under `.baton/integrate/` (`278–281`), runs merge/commit only in `stagePath` (`285–325`), and `removeStructuredIntegration` on any failure (`329–330`). `finalizeStructuredIntegration` is the sole main mutator via `--ff-only` (`342–343`). Coordinator always cleans verify path and stage in `finally`-style blocks (`coordinator.mjs:1161–1162`, `1176–1177`).

**Failure sequence (refusal leaves main untouched):** Accept worker result → dirty main with uncommitted bytes → `coordinator.integrate(..., { strategy: 'structured' })` → `structured_main_dirty` (`worktree.mjs:270`, test `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:105–110`) → HEAD and porcelain unchanged.

**GIT_* confinement:** `localGitEnv()` strips ambient `GIT_*`, sets `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1'` and `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: '/dev/null'` (`worktree.mjs:57–61`); merge/commit use `-c core.hooksPath=/dev/null` (`worktree.mjs:285`, `323`). Red: `GIT_INDEX_FILE` poison does not break clean three-way (`phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:95–103`).

### SM3 — exact Git identities

**Verdict: PASS.**

Staging records `beforeSha`, verified `resultSha`, `mergeBaseSha`, `stageSha`, `stagePath`, classes, resolutions (`worktree.mjs:274–277`, `325–328`). Refuses non-commit result (`272–273`), already-integrated result (`275–276`), and post-stage main advance (`336–341`). Candidate must have exactly two parents `[beforeSha, resultSha]` (`326–327`, `340–341`).

**Failure sequence (main-advance race):** Stage succeeds → main fast-forwards before finalize → `structured_main_advanced` (`worktree.mjs:339`, test `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:134–143`) → main stays at raced commit, stage reaped.

### SM4 — fail-closed conflict classification

**Verdict: FAIL — one actionable defect (binary output); otherwise PASS.**

**Implemented gates:** Clean merge → `clean_textual` (`289`). Unmerged paths require resolver (`291–292`). Path confinement via `pathRelative` and `isFile()` (`295–296`). Binary **input** via `conflict.includes(0)` (`297`). File budget pre/post resolve (`298`, `306`). Isolated resolver cwd outside repo (`299–303`, test asserts `isolatedCwd.startsWith(root) === false`, `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:77`). Parse fallback / unresolved / unknown refuse (`310–311`). Remaining unmerged index entries refuse (`319–320`). `git diff --check --cached` refuse (`321–322`). Line-anchored diff3 markers refuse via `CONFLICT_MARKER` (`254`, `312–313`; reds `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:43–54`).

**Actionable defect — binary resolver output not refused:**

| Step | Action | Location |
|------|--------|----------|
| 1 | Base repo; worker edits `src/value.js`; main diverges on same path | test harness `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:14–18` |
| 2 | Inject resolver: `writeFileSync(absolutePath, 'export const values = { alpha: 2 };\n\0evil')`; `return { status: 'resolved' }` | `worktree.mjs:303` |
| 3 | Input passes: no NUL in conflict blob (`297`), within `maxFileBytes` | `297–298` |
| 4 | Output passes: `merged.includes(0)` **not checked**; UTF-8 decode succeeds; no line-start marker | `306–313` |
| 5 | Bytes written to stage and committed (`314–325`); SM6 verification runs `node src/value.js` (may still exit 0) | `coordinator.mjs:1138–1157` |
| 6 | Main fast-forwards with NUL-corrupted text file | `finalizeStructuredIntegration` `342–343` |

**Non-goals / accepted limits:**
- Line-anchored markers only (`254`); inline `<<<<<<<` mid-line is not scanned — evidence documents line-start policy (`docs/handoff/evidence/phase26-structured-merge-2026-07-11.md:49–50`).

### SM5 — immutable candidate commit

**Verdict: PASS.**

Stage commits only after all paths resolved, index clean, and `diff --check` pass (`318–322`); merge commit message `baton structured integration: ${taskId}` (`323–324`); parent identity verified before return (`326–327`). Candidate is not main until SM7.

### SM6 — fresh post-merge verification

**Verdict: PASS.**

Coordinator builds **distinct** verify worktree at `stageSha` (`coordinator.mjs:1139–1140`), runs pinned primary via `_referee` (`1141–1144`), requires accept before finalize (`1145–1157`). Failure code `structured_verification_failed` (`1157`); main unchanged; stage/verify reaped (`1161–1162`). Event `integration.merge_reverified` logged (`1151–1155`). Red: invalid syntax after “resolved” (`phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:125–132`).

**Non-goal:** Verification command strength; spec admits pinned check may be weak (`spec/phase26/structured-merge.md:42–43`, evidence `57–59`).

### SM7 — one guarded main update

**Verdict: PASS.**

`finalizeStructuredIntegration` re-checks clean main at `beforeSha` (`337–339`), re-validates candidate parents (`340–341`), `merge --ff-only` (`342–343`). Success record includes SHAs, classes, resolutions, resolver identity, verdict (`coordinator.mjs:1158`, `1182–1186`). No push implied.

### SM8 — replay and authority

**Verdict: PASS.**

Operational `integration.completed` plus coordination batch required for replayed success. Phase 11 CK9: post-merge coordination failure poisons; replay shows `integration: null` (`phase11-acceptance-integration.test.mjs:301–322`); asymmetric Decision without driver authority rejected (`325–346`). Coordinator maps `structured_*` codes through on refusal (`coordinator.mjs:1174`).

### SM9 — cleanup and retention

**Verdict: PASS.**

`retainResult` before integration (`coordinator.mjs:1119–1121`); `releaseResult` on success (`1178–1180`); refusal retains ref (SM1 test `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:40`). Stage/verify removed on success and error (`1161–1162`, `1176–1177`). `reconcile` sweeps orphan `.baton/integrate/*` (`worktree.mjs:473–487`, test `phase26-structured-merge.test.mjs:169–179`). No stage branch created (detached `worktree add --detach`, `280`).

**Verdict: PASS.**

`coordinator.mjs` integration path has no Atlas/CPG/fingerprint hooks (grep empty). Structured advance requires SM6 verification; advisory signals cannot skip it per spec (`spec/phase26/structured-merge.md:64–70`). True semantic merge explicitly catalogued research non-goal.
